reason: Recommend `poly3`: it is a transparent degree-three polynomial field with fewer fitted values than the Gaussian network and the lowest combined-data uninterrupted RK4 state RMSE in this pool. Its final errors are about `0.023325` U_y on `data/train.csv` and `0.033375` U_y on `data/val.csv`; U_y denotes the unspecified state unit. Validation was included in final calibration, so these are not untouched holdout scores. Before final pooling, its training-derivative fit gave validation rollout RMSE about `0.036525` U_y and compared favorably with most compact nonlinear alternatives. The Gaussian model had a slightly lower screened holdout error but higher complexity and no final pooled advantage. The rational and smoothed power-law candidates hedge structural uncertainty, not coefficient uncertainty. No claim is made about unavailable test data.
